pr_body:
This fixes two test issues:

 - 1. Now the tests skip if the multi_dense_vector feature isn't enabled
 - 2. fixes silly bwc testing where we were testing for big-endian floats, which aren't possible.

closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/116862

review_comments: What happens when we remove this feature flag? Should we rather reply on more stable `SearchCapabilities`?

@mayya-sharipova feature flag is there as the initial work is all done over snapshot builds or specifically set behind a feature flag. This is OK here and if we ever remove the flag, that means its on and these setups can be removed. 

The capability checks are only for yaml test skipping to my knowledge.
